articles.body:
Videos YouTube labels “Made with AI” — quietly pulled from your feed , search , related videos and Shorts before you scroll past them. No blocking screens, no drama. The weeds are just gone.

Simulated. On a real feed a weed is gone in about half a second — cached ones never sprout at all.

Detection relies on YouTube’s own “Made with AI” disclosure badge — no guessing, no heuristics, no false accusations. Unlabeled slop is out of scope (for now).

Questions, bug reports, or a weed that slipped through? Email masteranza@gmail.com — include the video link if it’s about detection.

模拟一下：在真实信息流里，一棵“杂草”大约半秒内就没了——缓存过的根本长不出来。

检测靠的是 YouTube 自带的“Made with AI”披露标签——不猜、不用启发式算法（heuristics）、不会误判。没打标签的劣质内容暂时管不着。

articles.title: On the Design Fundamentals of Pixel Text Representation Learning
articles.zh: 论像素文本表示学习的设计基础
articles.summary: 如果你在做文档理解或多模态模型，这篇文章系统梳理了像素级文本表示的核心设计选择，能帮你避开常见坑。
articles.author: Chaohao Yuan, Ruifeng Yuan 等
articles.body: Text-rich visual inputs require models that can read, retrieve, and compress language directly in pixel space, yet existing pixel-text encoders struggle with fixed resolution pretraining, visual shortcut learning, weak visual grounding, and multilingual visual text understanding. In this work, we investigate the fundamental design principles required for robust visual text representation learning. Through systematic controlled ablations, we identify four critical components: variable image resolutions and rendered font sizes provide spatial proxies for high-resolution document generalization; natural image-text pairs are indispensable for grounding and prevent text-only collapse; layout-aware rendering helps prevent pixel-level shortcuts; and a two-stage multilingual curriculum enables effective cross-lingual alignment. By integrating these principles into a scalable training recipe, we train Pixel Linguist II, a native-resolution vision encoder trained with on-the-fly rendering, unified contrastive grounding, and a multilingual curriculum over 280M training examples. Pixel Linguist II sets new state-of-the-art results on English, cross-lingual, and multilingual Visual STS and ViDoRe, while also enabling better MLLM downstream evaluation. Notably, Pixel Linguist II remains robust under 80\% visual token compression, showing great promise for optical context compression. Our code and resources are available at https://github.com/Pixel-Linguist/Pixel-Linguist-II.
articles.bodyZh: 处理带文字的图像输入，模型得能直接在像素里读字、找信息、压缩语言，可现在的像素级文字编码器问题不少：训练时分辨率固定、模型爱走视觉捷径、对文字的定位能力弱、多语言场景下更是抓瞎。为了搞清楚怎么才能让模型稳健地学会视觉文字表示，我们做了一组系统性对照实验，最后锁定了四个关键设计点：第一，训练时要用变化的图像分辨率和不同的渲染字号，这样模型才能泛化到高分辨率文档；第二，自然图像-文本配对数据必不可少，它能让模型真正理解文字含义，防止模型只顾文字不管图像；第三，考虑版面布局的渲染方式能避免模型偷懒走捷径；第四，分两个阶段的多语言课程训练，能让模型学好跨语言对齐。把这些原则整合成一套可扩展的训练方案，我们训练出了Pixel Linguist II——一个原生分辨率视觉编码器，支持实时渲染、统一对比式图文对齐，外加280M训练样本的多语言课程。Pixel Linguist II在英文、跨语言和多语言的Visual STS和ViDoRe基准上都刷新了最优成绩，在下游多模态大语言模型评估里表现也更出色。更值得一提的是，即使把视觉token压缩掉80%，Pixel Linguist II依然稳得住，这对光学上下文压缩来说是个很棒的信号。代码和资源已开源：https://github.com/Pixel-Linguist/Pixel-Linguist-II

articles.title: StainPresetNet: Stain Preset Network for Fast Multi-to-Multi Stain Normalization
articles.zh: StainPresetNet：用于快速多对多染色归一化的染色预设网络
articles.summary: 如果你在处理病理切片图像，染色风格差异常让模型失效，这个网络能快速统一多来源染色风格，省去配对数据的麻烦。
articles.author: Hongtao Kang, Die Luo 等
articles.body: Stain normalization reduces color variations caused by variations in staining protocols and imaging conditions, thereby enhancing computer-aided diagnostic system performance. Traditional methods derive mapping relationships from individual or limited reference images through pixel-wise transformation, offering style flexibility but suffering from inaccurate color mapping extraction. While existing deep-learning-based approaches achieve accurate dataset-wide color mapping through complex neural networks, they face challenges including computational inefficiency, artifact generation, and fixed normalization directions requiring model retraining for directional changes. To address these limitations, we propose StainPresetNet - a novel framework that combines structural preservation with dataset-level color mapping while maintaining computational efficiency. Our method implements pixel-wise normalization guided by preset reference images, enabling multi-directional adaptability without retraining. Evaluations on cytopathology and histopathology datasets demonstrate that StainPresetNet achieves superior color mapping accuracy compared to conventional methods, effectively improves classifier generalization in diagnostic tasks, and reduces computational overhead by 90\% versus existing deep learning approaches. The proposed preset-guided mechanism facilitates flexible adjustment of normalization directions through simple reference image replacement, overcoming the directional rigidity of current deep-learning-based solutions.
articles.bodyZh:
染色归一化能有效消除染色方案和成像条件不同带来的颜色差异，从而提升计算机辅助诊断系统的表现。传统方法通常从单张或少量参考图像出发，通过逐像素变换来建立映射关系。这种方法虽然风格上比较灵活，但缺点是颜色映射的提取不够准确。而现有的深度学习方法虽然能靠复杂神经网络实现整个数据集级别的精准颜色映射，却也面临不少问题——计算效率低、容易产生伪影（artifact）、而且归一化方向固定，一旦要换方向就得重新训练模型。

为了解决这些短板，我们提出了StainPresetNet——一个兼顾结构保留、数据集级颜色映射和计算效率的新型框架。它的做法是借助预设参考图像实现逐像素归一化，这样就能做到无需重新训练便能适应多个方向的映射需求。我们在细胞病理学和组织病理学数据集上做了评估，结果显示，相比传统方法，StainPresetNet在颜色映射精准度上更胜一筹；在诊断任务中，它能有效提升分类器的泛化能力；而且相比现有深度学习方法，计算开销降低了90%。这个预设引导机制也让方向调整变得非常简单——只要换一张参考图就行，彻底解决了目前基于深度学习方法方向切换困难的问题。

articles.title: Revisiting Face Recognition for Monozygotic Twins: The Celeb Twins Test Set
articles.zh: 重新审视同卵双胞胎的人脸识别：Celeb Twins 测试集
articles.summary: 如果你做人脸识别算法，同卵双胞胎是区分能力的极限测试，这个新基准能暴露模型是否真的学到了细微特征。
articles.author: Michael Zang, Haiyu Wu 等
articles.body: Past literature on face recognition for monozygotic (("identical") twins points to facial marks and mirror asymmetry as possible directions for improved accuracy of twins recognition. The Celeb Twins Test Set (CTTS) contains web-scraped image pairs for 80 sets of celebrity twins. It is the only twins test set with meta-data for twins with distinguishing skin marks and possible mirror asymmetry. CTTS is organized in the manner of face verification test sets such as LFW, CALFW, CPLFW, CFP-FP, and AgeDB-30. Current deep CNN matchers can achieve over 76% accuracy in classifying CTTS same-person / different-person image pairs. We show that current matchers do not make use of skin marks, or asymmetry, and discuss reasons for this. Finally, we discuss the feasibility of using generative AI tools such as Grok, ChatGPT and Gemini to create images of imagined monozygotic twins as a means to increase representation of twins in face recognition training sets.
articles.bodyZh: 过去关于同卵双胞胎（也就是“一模一样”的双胞胎）人脸识别的研究表明，面部胎记和镜像不对称性可能是提高双胞胎识别准确率的方向。Celeb Twins 测试集（CTTS）收集了80对名人双胞胎的网上图片对，是目前唯一一个带有“区分性皮肤标记”和“可能镜像不对称”元数据的双胞胎测试集。它的组织方式和 LFW、CALFW、CPLW、CFP-FP、AgeDB-30 这些人脸验证测试集类似。现有的深度 CNN 匹配器在判断 CTTS 里图片对是不是同一个人时，准确率能超过76%。但我们发现，这些匹配器其实并没有利用皮肤标记或不对称性，我们讨论了一下原因。最后，我们还聊了聊用生成式 AI 工具（比如 Grok、ChatGPT 和 Gemini）来生成想象中的同卵双胞胎图片，从而增加人脸识别训练集中双胞胎样本的可行性。

articles.title: Does task decomposition improve automatic NLG evaluation?
articles.zh: 任务分解能否改进自动NLG评估？
articles.summary: 如果你平时用自动指标评估生成文本，这篇文章拆解了“分步骤评估”是否比直接打分更可靠，值得参考。
articles.author: Sebastian Steindl, Nikos Voskarides 等
articles.body: The LLM-as-a-judge (LLMaJ) framework has emerged as a promising solution for cheap, reproducible, reference-free Natural Language Generation (NLG) evaluation. Prior work seeks to improve LLMaJ by decomposing evaluation tasks into simpler sub-tasks. In this work, we systematically compare LLMaJ methods with and without decomposition on multiple NLG datasets. We find no evidence that LLMaJ with task decomposition leads to performance gains over a fair baseline that does not use decomposition. Instead, we find that previously reported performance gains in decomposition-based LLMaJ stem from using human labels as training data, and not task decomposition itself. Also, we find that, when human labels are available, LLMaJ without using task decomposition can perform comparably to human annotators.
articles.bodyZh: “大模型当裁判”（LLM-as-a-judge，简称LLMaJ）这种评估方式，最近被看作是一个既便宜、又能复现、还不用参考标准答案的自然语言生成（NLG）评估新招。以前的研究老想着把评估任务拆成更小的子任务来提升效果。但在这项工作里，我们系统地对比了“拆任务”和“不拆任务”的LLMaJ方法，跑了多个NLG数据集，结果发现：拆任务并没有比不拆任务的公平基线方法表现更好。换句话说，之前那些说“拆了更好”的结果，其实是因为用了人工标注数据来训练，而不是拆任务本身带来的好处。另外，我们还发现，在有现成人工标注的情况下，就算不拆任务，LLMaJ也能做到和人工评审差不多的水平。

articles.title: Overfitting Mitigation via Singular Value Decomposition in Minimum Bayes Risk Decoding
articles.zh: 最小贝叶斯风险解码中基于奇异值分解的过拟合缓解
articles.summary: 如果你在生成任务中使用MBR解码，SVD降维能削弱模型对候选集和参考样本的过拟合，让输出更稳定。
articles.author: Riza Setiawan Soetedjo, Yusuke Sakai 等
articles.body: Minimum Bayes Risk (MBR) decoding enables high-quality text generation by selecting the hypothesis that maximizes a utility metric over sampled pseudo-references. However, it is highly susceptible to metric overfitting: it can irregularly inflate the chosen utility metric at the direct expense of other unoptimized evaluation metrics. To mitigate this, we introduce SVD-MBR, which frames the pairwise utility matrix as a noisy information signal. By computing a low-rank approximation via Singular Value Decomposition (SVD) and retaining only the top-$k$ components, we effectively decouple true consensus from metric noise. Experiments demonstrate that SVD-MBR successfully regularizes decoding, yielding substantial gains across a range of generalized metrics. Furthermore, we reveal that this denoising is metric-dependent: neural metrics encode a robust low-rank consensus ideal for SVD, whereas surface-level metrics struggle to separate signal from metric noise.
articles.bodyZh:
最小贝叶斯风险（Minimum Bayes Risk, MBR）解码是一种高质量文本生成方法，它的核心思路是：先采样出一些伪参考（pseudo-references），然后从中挑一个能让效用指标（utility metric）得分最高的候选结果。听起来很美好，对吧？但问题在于，它特别容易对指标过拟合（overfitting）——也就是说，它可能会为了让某个选中的指标分数好看，而不惜牺牲其他没被优化的评估指标，导致分数出现不正常的虚高。

为了解决这个问题，我们提出了SVD-MBR。简单来说，就是把那个两两配对的效用矩阵（pairwise utility matrix）当成一个带有噪声的信息信号来处理。我们利用奇异值分解（Singular Value Decomposition, SVD）对它做低秩近似（low-rank approximation），只保留排名最靠前的k个成分，这样一来，就能把真正“共识”的部分和“指标噪声”有效地分离开。

实验结果表明，SVD-MBR确实能起到正则化（regularize）解码的作用，在一系列广义指标上都带来了显著的提升。更有意思的是，我们还发现这种“去噪”效果跟指标本身的类型密切相关：神经指标（neural metrics）天生就编码了一个稳健的低秩共识结构，特别适合用SVD来处理；而偏表面的指标（surface-level metrics）则很难把真实信号和指标噪声区分开。

articles.title: DNC-IMM: Early Lane-Change Intention Recognition via Neural Calibration Based on Driving Context Information
articles.zh: DNC-IMM：基于驾驶上下文信息进行神经校准的早期变道意图识别
articles.summary: 如果你做自动驾驶决策，这个模型利用上下文信息做神经校准，能更早预测变道意图，为系统留出反应时间。
articles.author: Woong-Chan Byun, Seung-Hyun Kong
articles.body: Early recognition of lane-change intention is essential for proactive decision-making in autonomous driving and advanced driver assistance systems. This paper proposes a Dual Neural-Calibrated Interacting Multiple Model (DNC-IMM) that improves adaptability to driving context while preserving the probabilistic structure and interpretability of a conventional IMM. The proposed method encodes driving-context information, including target-vehicle motion, gaps to surrounding vehicles, and relative velocities, with a neural network that calibrates both the transition-probability matrix and measurement likelihoods. The final intention is determined from the calibrated IMM mode posterior rather than from a separate direct classifier. Experiments on the highD dataset demonstrate that the proposed method reliably recognizes lane-change intentions before lane crossing and provides particularly strong performance at the earlier 2-3 s prediction horizons.
articles.bodyZh:
提前识别变道意图，对自动驾驶和高级驾驶辅助系统（ADAS）来说至关重要，因为这能帮车辆提前做出决策，而不是被动应对。这篇论文提出了一种叫“双神经校准交互式多模型”（DNC-IMM）的新方法，它既保留了传统交互式多模型（IMM）的概率结构和可解释性，又提升了对不同驾驶情境的适应能力。

具体来说，这个方法会用神经网络来编码驾驶环境信息，包括目标车辆的运动状态、与周围车辆之间的间隙、相对速度等，然后用这些信息去校准模型里的转移概率矩阵和测量似然。最终的变道意图判断，不是靠一个单独的分类器，而是直接基于校准后的IMM模式后验概率得出的。

在highD数据集上的实验结果显示，这个方法能在车辆真正越过车道线之前就可靠地识别出变道意图，尤其是在提前2到3秒的预测窗口内，表现得特别突出。

articles.title: Latent Recurrent Thoughts: Recurrent Refinement of Proposed Latents for Reasoning with Frozen LLMs
articles.zh: 潜在循环思考：面向冻结LLM推理的潜在表示循环精炼
articles.summary: 如果你想在不微调大模型的情况下提升推理能力，这篇用循环精炼隐变量的方法值得一试。
articles.author: Zhaoliang Chen, Jie Fu
articles.body: Chain-of-thought reasoning unfolds in discrete token space: each step is committed as text, errors propagate, and eliciting good traces presupposes traces to imitate. Reasoning instead in a model's continuous representation space - where intermediate states are vectors rather than words - sidesteps these constraints, but leaves open how those latent states should be computed. We approach this along two axes. First, we keep a large language model (LLM) frozen and use it for what it is already good at - modeling and decoding sequences - while a small auxiliary network supplies continuous latent thoughts as input. Second, we produce those latents by recurrence: a tiny recurrent reasoner refines them over many steps, decoupling the depth of computation from the size of the model, so that the latents are a product of iterative processing rather than a single forward pass. We instantiate this as Latent Recurrent Thoughts (LRT): a task-dedicated proposer supplies base latents, a recurrent reasoner refines them through bounded residual corrections, and the frozen LLM decodes the answer. On symbolic reasoning with answer supervision but no reasoning traces (Countdown-4, Sudoku) and on natural-language reasoning (HumanEval, MBPP, StrategyQA), LRT substantially outperforms prior frozen-decoder continuous-space reasoning methods under an identical decoder, prompt, data, and training budget, and outperforms non-thinking-mode chain-of-thought prompting on the same backbone at a small fraction of its inference compute.
articles.bodyZh: 思维链推理是在离散的token空间里展开的：每一步都被写成文字，错误会一步步累积扩散，而且想要得到好的推理轨迹，前提是得先有现成的轨迹可以模仿。但如果在模型的连续表示空间里做推理——也就是中间状态是向量而不是文字——就能绕开这些限制，但问题是，这些潜在状态到底该怎么算，依然没有答案。我们沿着两条路来解决。第一，让大语言模型（LLM）保持冻结不动，只把它用在它本来就擅长的事情上——建模和生成序列——而由一个小的辅助网络来提供连续的潜在思维作为输入。第二，我们用循环的方式来产生这些潜在状态：一个很小的循环推理器会逐步反复打磨这些状态，把计算的深度和模型的大小解耦开来，这样一来，潜在状态就不是一次前向传播的结果，而是反复迭代加工的产物。我们把这个方法实现为“潜在循环思维”（Latent Recurrent Thoughts，LRT）：一个任务专用的提议器负责生成基础潜在状态，一个循环推理器通过有界的残差修正来逐步优化它们，最后冻结的LLM再解码出答案。在只有答案监督、没有推理轨迹的符号推理任务（Countdown-4、 Sudoku）上，以及在自然语言推理任务（HumanEval、 MBPP、 StrategyQA）上，LRT在完全相同的解码器、提示词、数据和训练预算条件下，显著优于此前基于冻结解码器的连续空间推理方法；而且和同一个主干模型用非思维模式的思维链提示相比，LRT只用了一小部分推理算力就超过了它。

articles.title: EDRAC: Benchmarking Arabic Dialect Reading Comprehension
articles.zh: EDRAC：阿拉伯语方言阅读理解基准测试
articles.summary: 如果你做阿拉伯语NLP，这个基准填补了方言阅读理解的空白，可以拿来检验模型对多方言的真实理解力。
articles.author: Noor Abo Mokh, Kirill Chirkunov 等
articles.body: Dialectal Arabic (DA) remains under-resourced compared to Modern Standard Arabic (MSA), particularly for machine reading comprehension (MRC) and question answering (QA). Existing Arabic QA benchmarks primarily focus on formal written MSA or multiple-choice QA, with limited coverage of naturally spoken dialects. Here, we aim to bridge this gap. We introduce EDRAC, the first large-scale benchmark for dialectal Arabic machine reading comprehension (MRC) and generative QA, covering five major dialects: Egyptian, Moroccan, Emirati, Syrian, and Saudi Arabic. EDRAC contains 499 passages derived from naturally occurring spoken interactions and 4,977 corresponding QA pairs generated through a human--LLM collaborative pipeline combining iterative generation, LLM-as-a-judge evaluation, and human verification. We benchmark Arabic-centric and multilingual LLMs on EDRAC using lexical and semantic metrics. Our results reveal substantial gaps between semantic answer quality and dialectal fidelity, highlighting the limitations of existing evaluation metrics for dialectal Arabic generation. EDRAC provides a realistic and challenging MRC benchmark for future research on dialectal Arabic NLP.
articles.bodyZh:
阿拉伯语方言（DA）相比现代标准阿拉伯语（MSA），在资源上一直挺匮乏的，尤其是在机器阅读理解（MRC）和问答（QA）这些任务上。现在已有的阿拉伯语问答测试集，大多集中在正式的书面标准语，或者选择题形式的问答上，很少覆盖到自然口语中那些活生生的方言。这次我们就是想把这个空缺补上。

我们推出了一个新的大型基准测试集，叫 EDRAC，这是头一个专门针对阿拉伯语方言的机器阅读理解和生成式问答的大规模测试集，覆盖了五种主要方言：埃及、摩洛哥、阿联酋、叙利亚和沙特阿拉伯的阿拉伯语。EDRAC 包含 499 段从真实口语对话中整理出来的文本，以及 4977 个对应的问答对。这些问答对是人工和 AI 模型协作生成的，流程包括多次迭代生成题目、让 AI 当裁判打分，再加上人工把关验证。

我们在 EDRAC 上测试了好几款专注于阿拉伯语和多种语言的大模型语言模型，用词法指标和语义指标一起评估。结果显示，在语义答案质量和方言地道程度之间，还有不小的差距，这也暴露出目前评估体系对方言生成效果还不太够用。EDRAC 给未来的阿拉伯语方言自然语言处理研究提供了一个更贴近现实、也更有挑战性的机器阅读理解基准测试平台。
